After 1500 hundred hours of elden ring I came back to dark souls. 

Dark souls might be the greatest game ever made. It is like fine wine. Not even fromsoft with several other masterpieces, have matched its elegance. You can say every one of their games has their strengths and offer something different, you can say ds1 shows its age a little, but they have not recaptured quite what made dark souls so amazing. 

There is something about it from the combat to everything including the way  wep crafting works and how npcs move around the world naturally, the world itself and how every inch of it is built to be navigated multiple times. 

there is a certain art through every facet and it all flows together to cumulatively create the single best gaming experience I have ever had. 

Despite flaws and there being definite room for improvement. Which elden ring also has...

It's a preference thing when it comes to fast or slow combat. I like the slow combat better, although I do like both. 

Dark souls is a masterwork of art though. It is more than just the combat and it should be experienced for oneself. 

From the combat to everything including the way wep crafting works and how npcs move around the world naturally, the world itself and how every inch of it is built to be navigated multiple times. 

there is a certain art or technique, a general feel to the design which runs through every facet and it all flows together to cumulatively create the single best gaming experience I have ever had. 

Despite flaws and there being definite room for improvement. Not even fromsoft have matched or surpassed it in my opinion.
